findings.text: Direct write fallback helper reconciles progress from a direct attempt with progress from a buffered retry for one request, flushing and invalidating the affected cache range and adjusting the reported position and count on failure.

When the buffered portion failed the helper returns direct progress when any exists and otherwise the buffered error, and when cache writeback failed it rewinds the request position by the buffered amount before applying the same preference.

Buffered fallback data must be written back and waited upon over its byte range and then invalidated from the mapping before combined success is reported, otherwise direct semantics would be violated.

Stashed dentry prune helper clears a filesystem private stash slot that points at the calling dentry, staying silent when no inode is attached and only replacing the slot when it still holds the same dentry.
A missing stash slot is treated as a one time warning condition, indicating caller misuse rather than a normal empty case.
Lease enable default value is one, meaning leasing is on unless turned off through configuration.
Lease break grace default value is forty five, expressed in seconds of break time.

Filesystem control table publishes an enable knob named leases-enable and on memory management builds a break time knob named lease-break-time under fs with owner writable world readable permissions using integer vector handling registered at early init.
Per CPU file lock shard contains a spin lock for mutual exclusion together with a hash list head holding the resident lock records, with one shard instance per processor.
Blocked lock hash width is seven bits.
Deadlock search iteration bound is ten.

Blocked bookkeeping is serialized by a dedicated global spin lock, while context storage plus POSIX lock storage plus lease storage each live in a slab cache that becomes read only after initialization completes.

Owner blocker query holds the file context lock while walking POSIX entries, comparing each entry owner against the caller owner and reporting blocked status only from matching entries that have queued waiters.
Lease initializer clears an entire lease record to zero and then prepares its embedded core linkage so the object can be inserted into context lists and wait structures.

Flock command decoder converts a shared request to a read lock type and an exclusive request to a write lock type and an unlock request to an unlock type, rejecting every other value as invalid argument.
Local lease break callback signals asynchronous owners with an input output signal and a message poll event and returns false to indicate the caller must still handle removal.
Lease setup installs a caller provided async notification record into the lease record and assigns file ownership to the current thread group, clearing the caller handle when the table consumed it.

Open conflict logic grants a read lease only when no writer is present, ignores unknown modes, and grants a write lease only when the inode read and write counts exactly equal the contribution of the requesting file itself.
Open for write test is true exactly when the inode write count is greater than zero.
Local lease manager operations table groups four callbacks covering break notification plus lease change plus setup plus open conflict detection.

POSIX blocking waiter cycles between attempting acquisition and sleeping interruptibly until its blocked membership empties, exiting on success or terminal error or signal and always cleaning blocked state before returning.
Flock blocking waiter follows the same attempt then interruptible sleep cycle on its blocked membership, with final cleanup of blocked state regardless of outcome.

Lease conflict evaluation first exempts a breaker that already owns the target lease, then rejects mismatched layout character and delegation against lease mixing, otherwise delegating to the generic conflict test and tracing the boolean result.
Directory ignore mask is the union of the create ignore bit with the delete ignore bit with the rename ignore bit.

Ignore mask aggregation acquires the context lock and folds ignore bits from every lease on the inode, stopping early once all directory bits are present and returning zero when the inode has no locking context.
Directory break ignore test returns true when any requested break reason for create or delete or rename overlaps the corresponding ignore permission stored in the lease.

Break flag decoder translates a lease break request to lease type and a delegation break request to delegation type and a layout break request to layout type, yielding zero for any other flag combination.
First visible lease search must be called with the context lock already held and returns the earliest lease that conflicts with the proposed breaker and is not ignored for directory operations.

Lease break entry validates the break type from flags, builds a temporary breaker object with read or write intent, expires timed out leases, and marks each remaining conflicting lease as pending while invoking its break callback.

Lease breaking holds a filesystem read barrier across the whole scan and the inode context lock during list inspection and marking, dropping both while sleeping and reacquiring them before each recheck and disposing removed leases outside the locks.

When conflicts remain after marking, the breaker either fails immediately for nonblocking callers or enqueues itself as blocked and sleeps interruptibly with a timeout, on wakeup expiring timed out leases and looping until no visible conflict remains.

Break deadlines are computed from a global grace interval scaled by timer frequency added to current time, with zero normalized to a sentinel meaning no deadline and expired deadlines refreshed on each wait iteration.
Lease mtime helper overwrites the supplied timestamp with current time only when the inode carries at least one write lease, otherwise leaving the input unchanged.

Lease acquisition prepares async owner storage and obtains the inode locking context, trylocking the inode itself for delegation requests and then expiring old leases and checking for conflicting opens under read barrier and context lock.

During acquisition an entry for the same file and owner is treated as an upgrade candidate while any other lease vetoes an exclusive request and any pending unlock vetoes fresh acquisition, with upgrades performed through the manager change callback.

Fresh insertion proceeds only when global leasing is enabled, then issues a memory barrier and rechecks for conflicting opens, unlinking and aborting the new lease when a concurrent open raced between the first check and insertion.
Inode trylock attempts a nonblocking write acquisition of the inode semaphore and reports whether it succeeded without sleeping.
Lease deletion scans the inode lease list for an entry matching both file and owner and releases it through a change to unlock, returning a retryable failure when no context or no match exists.

Generic lease setter accepts only regular files and directories, routes unlock to deletion, rejects write leases on directories, requires a break callback for new leases, and validates the requested mode.
Lease event notification uses a sleepable read copy chain that is initialized once and managed through register and unregister operations for subscriber blocks.
Generic inode blocking waiter dispatches POSIX flagged requests to the POSIX waiter and flock flagged requests to the flock waiter.
An unrecognized combination of POSIX and flock flags in the generic waiter is treated as a fatal programming error.

Flock system call ignores mandatory lock attempts with a one time warning and immediate success, then decodes the remaining command after stripping nonblocking, validates the descriptor and read or write access for non unlock, and enforces the file security hook.

The call marks the request sleepable unless nonblocking was specified, prefers a filesystem custom flock handler with blocking or nonblocking semantics when present and otherwise uses the generic waiter, always releasing private lock resources before returning.
File based blocking waiter resolves its file to the underlying inode and delegates to the inode waiter, while the header fallback for builds without locking support reports missing lock capability.
Lock cancellation helper warns on file mismatch and forwards to the filesystem lock operation with cancel intent when available, otherwise reporting success without action.
Inode lock presence test returns false when no locking context exists and otherwise reports whether either the POSIX list or the flock list is nonempty while holding the context lock.
Lock listing iterator stores a processor index for per CPU shard traversal together with a one based display position.

Blocked lock listing views blocker links as parent pointers with first blocked request as left child and next blocked sibling as right child, descending and backtracking to emit nested entries with depth indication.
Listing suppresses records whose process identifier translates to zero in the viewing namespace.

Listing start acquires the filesystem write barrier and the blocked bookkeeping lock and positions on a per CPU hash shard by global offset, while the next operation advances within a shard then onward to the next nonempty shard on a later processor.
Lock module requests tracepoint instantiation in its own translation unit.
